primitives.meaning: a no-show authoritatively recorded against one confirmed booking; the semantics it was judged under and the window that closed; policy naming rebooking rather than a fee as what follows
entryFilters: a no-show is recorded against one booking occurrence by the attendance source
the booking, re-read after the recording lag, genuinely did not happen - not moved, cancelled or attended after all
the provider or resource could have delivered; a failure on our side goes to reschedule, not follow-up

primitives.does: Re-read the booking's latest events before anything leaves the building. Attendance and cancellation events land late, and the gap between the record being written and the message being sent is exactly where a correct cancellation gets treated as a miss

primitives.asks: Did the booking genuinely not happen?

branches.label: Superseded or reconciled
branches.test: a cancellation, a reschedule or a late attendance event has landed since the no-show was recorded

branches.label: Genuinely missed
branches.test: the record still stands after the re-read

primitives.state: nothing sent; the booking was moved, cancelled or attended after all
primitives.reEntry: a later booking that is genuinely missed is its own instance

primitives.asks: Could the provider or resource actually have delivered?

branches.label: Deliverable
branches.test: the provider and the resource were available and able to deliver for the whole window

branches.label: Our side failed
branches.test: the provider, the resource or the location could not have delivered the booking as confirmed

primitives.on: a missed booking the provider or resource could not have delivered
carries: the window that closed and what was already said to the customer about it
the evidence that delivery was not possible on our side

branches.label: Rebooking available
branches.test: the same commitment can still be met and capacity for it exists

branches.label: Nothing to rebook onto
branches.test: the commitment has lapsed, the entitlement behind it has gone, or no capacity remains

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the offer carries the rebooking route and should be kept - the default

primitives.purpose: State plainly that the booking did not happen and what that means, with no rebooking prompt attached because there is nothing to rebook onto.
primitives.brief: State plainly that the booking did not happen and what that means, with no rebooking prompt attached because there is nothing to book. An offer with nothing behind it costs more trust than saying nothing would
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the offer carries the rebooking route and should be kept - the default
permission for service messages on the channel is recorded and the rebooking window is short

primitives.purpose: Say that the booking was missed as a fact, without penalty language, and give the single route to a new one within the stated window.
primitives.brief: Say that the booking was missed as a fact, without penalty language, and give the single route to a new one with the date that route closes. Attaching blame to the miss makes rebooking a confession, and people do not book to confess
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

cancelOn.meaning: a new booking is created for the same commitment
the customer declines a further booking

primitives.reads: bookings for the same commitment re-read: a new booking created, a decline recorded, or nothing

branches.label: Rebooked
branches.test: a new booking exists against the same commitment

branches.label: Declined
branches.test: the customer said they do not want another booking

primitives.reEntry: the new booking has its own lifecycle and a later miss enters here again
a request from the customer later reopens booking through the ordinary route, not through this one
